name: Camp Evergreen
description_short: A summer camp in Harold Parker State Forest in Andover, MA, with lakes, ponds and hiking trails. Activities include swimming, canoeing, football and woodshop, and the camp also runs a spring vacation week.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp is in Harold Parker State Forest, with lakes and ponds on site. Swimming and canoeing are offered. The page does not say whether lifeguards are on duty or how swim levels are tested.
